benchmarks/fixture/auth.py:4:issue_sessi.name: issue_session_token
benchmarks/fixture/auth.py:4:issue_sessi.text: Fixture code: a session token being minted, giving the golden set a declaration to retrieve for questions about signing and credentials. 中文：夹具代码：签发一个会话令牌，为黄金集合里关于签名与凭证的问题提供一个可检索的声明。

benchmarks/fixture/auth.py:9:verify_sess.name: verify_session_token
benchmarks/fixture/auth.py:9:verify_sess.text: Fixture code: a token being checked for validity and expiry, the answer to the golden question phrased entirely in words the code does not use. 中文：夹具代码：校验一个令牌是否有效、是否过期——黄金集合里那道完全用代码不使用的词提问的题，答案就是它。

benchmarks/fixture/notifications.py:4:se.name: send_email
benchmarks/fixture/notifications.py:4:se.text: Fixture code: an outbound message being sent, one of the unrelated declarations a ranking has to rank below the actual answer. 中文：夹具代码：发出一条外发消息——排序必须把它排在真正答案之下的那些无关声明之一。

benchmarks/fixture/notifications.py:9:en.name: enqueue_webhook
benchmarks/fixture/notifications.py:9:en.text: Fixture code: an outbound event being queued for asynchronous delivery, and the answer to one golden question about queueing. 中文：夹具代码：把一个外发事件排入队列以便异步投递；黄金集合里关于排队的那道题，答案就是它。

benchmarks/fixture/payments.py:13:refund.name: refund_payment
benchmarks/fixture/payments.py:13:refund.text: Fixture code: money going back the other way, close enough to the charge path to make ranking between them a real decision. 中文：夹具代码：钱往回走的那条路——它与扣款路径足够接近，使两者之间的排序成为一个真实的判断。

benchmarks/fixture/payments.py:4:retry_c.name: retry_charge
benchmarks/fixture/payments.py:4:retry_c.text: Fixture code: a failed card charge being retried with backoff, the declaration most of the golden and description examples are phrased around. 中文：夹具代码：一次失败的刷卡扣款带退避重试——黄金集合与描述示例大多围绕这个声明来提问。

benchmarks/fixture/search.py:4:rank_docu.name: rank_documents
benchmarks/fixture/search.py:4:rank_docu.text: Fixture code: a toy ranking function, present so the fixture contains a declaration whose vocabulary overlaps this project's own. 中文：夹具代码：一个玩具排序函数，存在的目的是让夹具里有一个词汇与本项目自身重叠的声明。

benchmarks/fixture/search.py:9:build_sea.name: build_search_index
benchmarks/fixture/search.py:9:build_sea.text: Fixture code: a toy index builder sharing a name with this project's real one, which is exactly the collision a ranking should not be confused by. 中文：夹具代码：一个与本项目真实实现同名的玩具索引构建器——正是排序不应该被搞混的那种撞名。

benchmarks/fixture/workflow.py:6:checkou.name: checkout_invoice
benchmarks/fixture/workflow.py:6:checkou.text: Fixture code: a declaration that calls into the payment path, giving graph expansion a real edge to walk rather than a synthetic one. 中文：夹具代码：一个调用进支付路径的声明，让图扩展有一条真实的边可走，而不是一条合成的边。

benchmarks/large_repo.py:164:main.name: main
benchmarks/large_repo.py:164:main.text: Runs the scale measurement and writes its archive, which is what the published figures are quoted from. 中文：跑规模测量并写出归档——公开的那些数字就是从这里引用的。

benchmarks/large_repo.py:32:_memory_mb.name: _memory_mb
benchmarks/large_repo.py:32:_memory_mb.text: Reads resident memory from the operating system, since the point of the scale benchmark is the bound rather than the average. 中文：从操作系统读取常驻内存——规模基准关心的是上界而不是平均值。

benchmarks/large_repo.py:40:_memory_mb.C.name: _memory_mb.Counters
benchmarks/large_repo.py:40:_memory_mb.C.text: The structure the platform fills in with process memory counters. 中文：平台用进程内存计数填充的那个结构体。

benchmarks/large_repo.py:60:_max_rss_mb.name: _max_rss_mb
benchmarks/large_repo.py:60:_max_rss_mb.text: The peak rather than the current figure, because a build that briefly doubles is a build that fails on a smaller machine. 中文：取峰值而不是当前值——一次短暂翻倍的构建，就是一次在更小的机器上会失败的构建。

benchmarks/large_repo.py:64:create_repo.name: create_repo
benchmarks/large_repo.py:64:create_repo.text: Generates a synthetic repository of a chosen size, so scale can be measured without needing a real one that large. 中文：按指定规模生成一个合成仓库，使规模可以在没有那么大的真实仓库的情况下被测量。

benchmarks/large_repo.py:70:measure.name: measure
benchmarks/large_repo.py:70:measure.text: Measures a full build, an incremental rebuild after one file changes, storage size, load time, memory and query latency: the envelope inside which the readable JSON storage is known to be adequate. 中文：测量全量构建、单文件变动后的增量重建、存储体积、加载时间、内存与查询延迟——即「可读 JSON 存储已知够用」的那个包络。

benchmarks/measure_index.py:15:main.name: main
benchmarks/measure_index.py:15:main.text: Measures one existing index rather than a generated one, for when the question is about a real repository. 中文：测量一个已存在的索引而不是生成的索引，用于问题针对真实仓库的场合。

benchmarks/repo_queries.py:152:evaluate..name: evaluate.summarise
benchmarks/repo_queries.py:152:evaluate..text: Averages the answerable questions into hit rates, reciprocal rank, and the two figures that describe how retrieval declined: results resting on no lexical evidence, and questions it refused to answer. 中文：把可回答的题平均成命中率、倒数排名，以及描述「检索如何拒答」的两个数字：建立在零词面证据上的结果，以及它拒绝回答的题目数。

benchmarks/repo_queries.py:173:evaluate..name: evaluate.silence
benchmarks/repo_queries.py:173:evaluate..text: Averages the unanswerable questions into the one figure that describes them: how often nothing was returned, which is the only correct reply. 中文：把不可回答的题平均成描述它们的唯一一个数字：有多大比例什么都没返回——那是唯一正确的答复。

benchmarks/repo_queries.py:207:_report.name: _report
benchmarks/repo_queries.py:207:_report.text: Prints the report for a person, including which questions were missed and which unanswerable ones were answered anyway, since the useful thing about a wrong answer is always which unit it was and on what evidence. 中文：给人打印报告，包括哪些题错过了、哪些不可回答的题还是被回答了——一个错误答案里有用的部分，永远是「它是哪个单元」和「凭什么证据」。

benchmarks/repo_queries.py:240:main.name: main
benchmarks/repo_queries.py:240:main.text: The command line: chooses which index and which question set to grade, accepts a repository where an index file is expected, and lets a caller override the thresholds it is measuring. 中文：命令行：选择评判哪个索引、哪个题集，在期待索引文件的地方也接受一个仓库目录，并允许调用方覆盖它正在测量的那些阈值。

benchmarks/repo_queries.py:57:load_quest.name: load_questions
benchmarks/repo_queries.py:57:load_quest.text: Reads one question set. The count lives in the file rather than in any sentence about it, because a figure restated in prose is a claim nothing checks. 中文：读入一个题集。数量存在文件里而不是任何一句关于它的话里——散文里重述的数字是一个没人核对的断言。

benchmarks/repo_queries.py:61:check_rule.name: check_ruler
benchmarks/repo_queries.py:61:check_rule.text: Checks the ruler before anything is scored: every listed answer must name a unit that exists, and a question claiming its subject is absent must not also list one. A ruler that quietly stopped referring to real code would report improvement by losing its own questions. 中文：在打分之前先检查尺子：每个列出的答案都必须指向真实存在的单元；而一道声称其主题不存在的题，不能同时列出答案。一把悄悄不再指向真实代码的尺子，会靠丢掉自己的题目来报告进步。

benchmarks/repo_queries.py:94:evaluate.name: evaluate
benchmarks/repo_queries.py:94:evaluate.text: Grades one question set, keeping answerable and unanswerable questions apart. Overrides are passed to the search call rather than set on the module: a default argument is bound when the function is defined, so assigning the module attribute afterwards changes nothing and produces a sweep in which every threshold scores identically. 中文：给一个题集打分，并把「可回答」与「不可回答」的题分开。覆盖项是传给检索调用的，而不是设在模块上：默认参数在函数定义时就已绑定，事后改模块属性什么也改不了，只会产出一份「每个阈值得分都一样」的扫描结果。

benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:104:run.opti.name: run.optimized_search
benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:104:run.opti.text: The hybrid strategy with its inverted index built once outside the timing loop, so what is measured is querying rather than indexing. 中文：混合策略，其倒排表在计时循环之外只建一次，因此量的是查询而不是建索引。

benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:149:main.name: main
benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:149:main.text: Runs the benchmark and writes its report, so continuous integration and a person get the same numbers from the same command. 中文：跑基准并写出报告，使持续集成与人从同一条命令得到同一批数字。

benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:32:lexical_s.name: lexical_search
benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:32:lexical_s.text: The baseline the hybrid ranking is compared against: plain word overlap, no fields, no rarity, no vectors. A change that beats nothing proves nothing, so the comparison needs a floor to stand on. 中文：混合排序所对照的基线：纯粹的词面重叠，不分字段、不看稀有度、不用向量。一个只赢过空气的改动什么也证明不了，所以比较需要一个可以立足的地板。

benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:44:_is_relev.name: _is_relevant
benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:44:_is_relev.text: Decides whether one retrieved unit is one of the answers a question listed. 中文：判定某个检索到的单元，是不是某道题所列出的答案之一。

benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:48:_metrics.name: _metrics
benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:48:_metrics.text: Turns one ranked list into recall and reciprocal rank, which are the two figures the golden set is asserted on. 中文：把一份排好序的结果变成召回率与倒数排名——正是黄金集合据以断言的那两个数字。

benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:60:evaluate.name: evaluate
benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:60:evaluate.text: Scores one retrieval strategy across every question and records its timings, repeating each query so a single slow first run does not read as a regression. 中文：给一种检索策略在所有题目上打分并记录耗时；每个查询重复多次，使单次缓慢的首轮不会读作性能退步。

benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:90:run.name: run
benchmarks/run_benchmark.py:90:run.text: Runs the whole comparison and returns the report continuous integration asserts against. Quality figures are a user-facing contract; timings are recorded but never asserted, because a shared build machine has no stable clock. 中文：跑完整个对比，返回持续集成据以断言的报告。质量数字是面向用户的契约；耗时只记录、从不断言——共享的构建机器没有稳定的时钟。

src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:10:_result_id.text: Collects the unit identifiers out of a list of search results, so two result sets can be compared for overlap or novelty. Used to decide whether a second retrieval round actually surfaced anything new. 中文：从检索结果里抽出单元 ID 集合，用于比较两批结果是否重合、有无新发现；判断第二轮扩展是否带来了新证据。

src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:14:_serialize.text: Converts search results into plain JSON-ready dictionaries for the agent protocol reply. 中文：把检索结果转成可直接 JSON 序列化的字典，供 agent 协议应答使用。

src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:42:_trace.name: _trace
src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:42:_trace.text: One retrieval round reduced to what makes it checkable: which units it reached, how strongly, and on which words. A step exists so a caller can see how an answer was arrived at, not to hand back the answer a second time -- reporting both rounds in full meant serialising the same eight units three times with their source attached. 中文：把一轮检索压成可核查的最小形态——它够到了哪些单元、分数多高、命中哪些词。步骤是为了让调用方看清答案怎么来的，不是把答案再发一遍；两轮都完整回报曾导致同一批单元连源码被序列化三次。

src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:57:dominance.name: dominance
src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:57:dominance.text: How far the best answer leads the second-best, as a fraction of the best. A ratio between two numbers produced by the same query under the same scoring rule, so scaling every score changes nothing -- which is the entire point. The absolute threshold it replaced was tied to a scoring scale; when ranking changed, the scale moved out from under it and the decision it guarded silently stopped happening. 中文：最好的答案领先第二名多少，按最好者的比例计。它是同一次查询、同一套打分下两个数的比值，因此整体缩放分数不改变结果——这正是要点。它取代的绝对阈值绑在打分量纲上，排序一改量纲就移走了，它守护的判断于是悄无声息地不再发生。

src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:84:research.name: research
src/ragyourcode/agentic.py:84:research.text: Answers an ambiguous question in at most two observable retrieval rounds and says why it stopped. When the first round returns nothing, it reports which kind of nothing and stops there: a second round cannot recover a question whose words are not in this index, so spending the budget to arrive at the same silence helps no one. The published set of stop reasons is unchanged and the detail arrives in a field beside it, because widening an enumeration callers already branch on is a breaking change wearing the clothes of an improvement. 中文：用至多两轮可观察的检索回答一个含糊的问题，并说明为何停下。第一轮什么都没有时，它报告这是哪一种「什么都没有」并就此停住：第二轮救不了一个词汇根本不在索引里的问题，花掉预算走到同样的沉默对谁都没有好处。已发布的停止原因取值集合保持不变，细节放在旁边一个新字段里——扩大一个调用方已经在据以分支的枚举，是一次穿着改进外衣的破坏性变更。

src/ragyourcode/annotate.py:14:describe_.text: Builds a readable sentence about a Python function or class without using a language model: the humanised name, the arguments it accepts, the functions it calls, the modules it uses, and the docstring appended verbatim as stated intent. Because it only rearranges words already in the source, it adds no vocabulary the code did not have, which is why retrieval cannot reach a concept nobody wrote down. 中文：不调用任何模型，为 Python 函数或类拼出一句可读描述：名字还原、接受的参数、调用的函数、用到的模块，最后原样附上 docstring。它只重排源码里已有的词，不产生新词汇——这正是检索够不到无人写下的概念的原因。

src/ragyourcode/annotate.py:33:comment_f.text: Formats one numbered sidecar comment line combining a unit serial number, its identifier and its description. Language-neutral text, written to a separate annotations file so the source is never rewritten. 中文：把单元的序号、ID 与描述格式化成一行编号注释。与语言无关，写进独立的注解文件，绝不改动用户源码。

src/ragyourcode/annotate.py:9:_humanize.text: Turns a programmer identifier into ordinary words: splits camelCase apart, replaces underscores with spaces, lowercases the result. Empty input becomes a placeholder rather than an empty string. 中文：把标识符还原成普通词语——拆开驼峰、下划线换空格、转小写；空输入给占位名而非空串。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:105:_cmd_bootstra.name: _cmd_bootstrap
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:105:_cmd_bootstra.text: The front door for a repository nobody has set up yet: index it, then say what still stands between it and answering questions. Indexing is not the same as being searchable, and nothing used to say so -- a fresh index matches only words the source already contained. Prints the rung and its work for a person, or the same report as JSON for an agent. 中文：面向尚未配置过的仓库的入口：先建索引，再说出它距离能回答问题还差什么。建了索引不等于可检索，而此前没有任何东西讲明这一点——全新索引只能匹配源码里本就有的词。给人打印当前所处的一级及其工作，给 agent 输出同一份 JSON 报告。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:135:_cmd_annotate.text: The annotate command: writes a numbered inventory of every indexed unit to a separate document, with its location, kind and description. Source files are never touched. Refuses to run against an index that no longer describes the repository, since a numbered inventory of stale code is worse than none. 中文：annotate 命令——把每个已索引单元的编号清单写进一份独立文档，含位置、种类与描述，绝不改动源文件。索引已不描述当前仓库时拒绝执行：一份过时代码的编号清单比没有更糟。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:150:_cmd_config.text: The config command: creates a commented settings file, lists every setting with its effective value and whether it was customised, reads one value, changes one value in place, or reports where the file lives. Changing a value refuses anything out of range before writing, so a rejected change leaves the file exactly as it was, and the reply says whether the change forces a full rebuild. Creating refuses to overwrite an existing file unless told to. 中文：config 命令——生成带注释的配置文件、列出每项设置的生效值与是否被改过、读取单项、就地修改单项、或报告文件位置。修改前先校验越界并在写盘前拒绝，因此被拒的修改不会改动文件分毫；应答会说明该改动是否强制全量重建。创建时除非明确要求，否则拒绝覆盖已有文件。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:172:_cmd_search.name: _cmd_search
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:172:_cmd_search.text: Answers one question from the published index and prints it, as a readable block for a person or machine-readable output for an agent. When nothing comes back it prints why rather than a bare 'no matching code units', because 'not in this repository', 'asked in the wrong words' and 'the index is broken' are three different next moves and the caller cannot tell them apart from silence. Result count, context budget, the balance between word overlap and similarity, how far similarity may widen the candidate set, and how much of a question must occur before it is answered all fall back to the repository settings. 中文：从已发布的索引回答一个问题并输出——给人是可读块，给 agent 是机器可读格式。什么都没有时它打印原因，而不是一句干巴巴的「没有匹配的代码单元」，因为「本仓库没有这东西」「问法不对」「索引坏了」是三个完全不同的下一步，而调用方从沉默里分辨不出是哪一个。返回条数、上下文预算、词面与相似度的配比、相似度可把候选集放宽多少、以及一个问题要有多少落在索引里才作答，都回落到仓库设置。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:270:_cmd_describe.name: _cmd_describe
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:270:_cmd_describe.text: The round trip for text an agent writes about code: report coverage, export a batch of work with its source and brief, take the written text back, or emit a patch that moves it into the source. Importing says outright that a rebuild is needed, because the published index still holds the previous wording and no source file moved to signal it. 中文：agent 为代码写文字的一次往返：报告覆盖率、导出带源码与写作要求的一批工作、收回写好的文字、或产出把文字搬进源码的补丁。导入时明确告知需要重建，因为已发布的索引仍持有旧措辞，而没有任何源文件的变动会提示这一点。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:28:_default_index.text: Where a repository index file is kept when the caller names no other location. 中文：调用方未指定位置时，仓库索引文件的默认存放路径。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:328:_open_source.text: Reads a slice of a file for an agent, refusing anything outside the repository and bounding the reply twice, by file size and by returned characters. Two bounds because a line count is not a size: a three-line file holding one enormous line satisfied the old line-based limit and returned megabytes on a single output line. Output that hits the character bound is truncated and says so. 中文：为 agent 读取文件的一段，拒绝仓库之外的路径，并按文件大小与返回字符数双重限制。之所以两重：行数不等于体积——一个三行但单行极长的文件满足旧的行数限制，却在一行输出里返回了数兆字节。触及字符上限的输出会被截断并明确标注。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:365:_request_int.text: Clamps a numeric field from an incoming request into its allowed range. The clamp has to survive values that are not ordinary numbers: an enormous literal becomes infinity, and converting infinity to a whole number raises an error that is neither of the two the request loop originally caught, so a single such request terminated the whole session. Saturating at the bound is the reading the caller intended anyway. 中文：把请求中的数值字段夹到允许范围内。这个夹取必须扛得住非常规数值：极大的字面量会变成无穷大，而把无穷大转成整数抛出的错误不属于请求循环原本捕获的那两类，一条这样的请求就终止了整个会话。饱和到边界本来也就是调用方想表达的意思。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:39:_refresh_index.name: _refresh_index
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:39:_refresh_index.text: Builds or rebuilds a repository index and publishes it, reusing what it can. It settles up front whether the rules deciding what a unit is have changed, and whether the authored descriptions moved — the third input no content fingerprint can see, and the only one where an edit in one direction used to be lost: a deleted description went on being served out of the reused unit that still carried it. One embedder is built here and handed to every stage, so the vectors stored and the queries later asked come from the same scheme by construction. 中文：构建或重建仓库索引并发布，尽可能复用。它先行判定「什么算一个单元」的规则是否变过，以及人写的描述有没有变动——那是内容指纹看不见的第三个输入，也是唯一一个曾在某个方向上会丢失编辑的输入：被删除的描述会继续从那个仍带着它的复用单元里被端出来。嵌入器在此建一次并交给各阶段，因此存下的向量与之后的查询由构造保证同源。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:405:_cmd_agent.name: _cmd_agent
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:405:_cmd_agent.text: Serves one JSON request per line for as long as an agent keeps the process alive, so a session pays the parse-and-embed cost once instead of per question. Every reply carries the same shape whether or not it found anything: the diagnosis field is null when there were results, so a caller reads one field rather than inferring from an empty list which of several quite different situations it is in. Every failure is reported in-band and the loop survives it. 中文：只要 agent 让进程活着，就按行服务 JSON 请求，使一次会话只付一次解析与嵌入的代价，而不是每问一次付一次。无论有没有找到东西，每个回复的形状都一样：有结果时诊断字段为空，因此调用方读一个字段就够了，不必从一个空列表去推断自己身处几种截然不同情形中的哪一种。所有失败都在带内回报且循环存活。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:514:build_parser.name: build_parser
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:514:build_parser.text: The single place every command, flag and default is declared, which is what lets a test execute the documentation: whatever the README or the skill tells someone to type must resolve to something here. Defaults are read from the settings table rather than repeated, so a documented default and the real one cannot drift apart. 中文：所有命令、选项与默认值的唯一声明处，这正是让测试能够执行文档的前提：README 或 skill 让人敲的任何东西，都必须在这里解析得到。默认值取自设置表而非重复书写，因此文档里的默认值与真实默认值不会各说各话。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:535:_use_utf8_str.text: Pins the process input and output to the encoding the protocol promises, instead of inheriting whatever the console locale happens to be. Without it a non-Western console cost correctness twice: printing a result containing a character the console could not represent raised an error and killed a long-running agent, and an incoming query was mis-decoded into text matching nothing, returning an empty answer with a success code. A stream that refuses to be reconfigured keeps its own encoding rather than failing the command. 中文：把进程输入输出钉在协议承诺的编码上，而不是继承控制台区域设置。没有它，非西文控制台会两次损害正确性：输出含控制台无法表示的字符时抛错并杀死常驻 agent；传入的查询被错误解码成匹配不到任何东西的乱码，返回空结果却带成功退出码。拒绝重配的流保留自身编码，而不是让整条命令失败。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:610:main.name: main
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:610:main.text: The single entry point for every command, and where failures become exit codes instead of tracebacks. A bad settings file and an unreachable embedding provider are each surfaced separately from the generic handler, because each has a fix in one known place and a message naming it is actionable where a stack trace is not. 中文：所有命令的唯一入口，也是失败在此变成退出码而非堆栈回溯的地方。配置文件有误与嵌入 provider 不可达各自从通用处理中单独拎出——因为两者的修复都在一个已知的地方，点名说出它的消息是可行动的，而堆栈回溯不是。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:88:_cmd_index.text: The index command: scans a repository and writes its index, reporting how many units and relationships were found and how many descriptions are still pending. 中文：index 命令——扫描仓库并写出索引，报告找到多少单元与关系、还有多少描述待写。

src/ragyourcode/cli.py:96:_load.name: _load
src/ragyourcode/cli.py:96:_load.text: Opens a published index for a read-only command and settles whether it is still current. Three things can make it out of date and only one of them is a file edit: the repository content can have moved, the rules that decide what a unit is can have changed, or the written descriptions can have changed. Neither authored input nor the parser is an indexed file, so each has to report itself. 中文：为只读命令打开已发布的索引，并判定它是否仍然当前。三件事可使其过期，其中只有一件是文件改动：仓库内容变了、决定单元是什么的规则变了、已写描述变了。两项手写输入与解析器都不是被索引的文件，因此各自必须自行上报。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:196:Config.text: The resolved settings for one repository, addressed by dotted name, together with the file they came from if any. 中文：某个仓库解析完成的设置，按点分名称访问，并记录它们来自哪个文件（如果有）。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:202:Config.__g.text: Reads one resolved setting by its dotted name. 中文：按点分名称读取一项已解析的设置。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:206:Config.bui.text: A digest of only those settings that determine what an index contains: which directories are skipped, which file suffixes count as source, the size cap, and the vector width. An index built under different values is not a stale index of this repository, it is an index of something else, so a mismatch forces a full rebuild rather than reuse. The vector width case matters most because it fails silently otherwise: ranking simply skips the similarity term when widths disagree, so the only symptom would be quietly worse results. 中文：只对『决定索引内容』的那几项设置取摘要——跳过哪些目录、哪些后缀算源码、单文件大小上限、向量维度。用不同取值建出的索引不是本仓库的陈旧索引，而是另一个东西的索引，因此不一致时强制全量重建而非复用。维度这一项尤其重要：不一致时排序只是跳过相似度项，唯一症状是结果悄悄变差。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:220:Config.wit.text: Layers explicitly supplied values on top of the resolved ones, ignoring any left unset. An unset command-line flag has to mean no opinion rather than clear this, or every flag would need its own sentinel default duplicating the settings table. 中文：把显式给定的值叠加在已解析设置之上，未给定的一律忽略。命令行未传的开关必须解读为『无意见』而非『清空』，否则每个开关都要自带哨兵默认值，等于把设置表复制一遍。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:236:_coerce.name: _coerce
src/ragyourcode/config.py:236:_coerce.text: Validates one configured value against its declared kind and bounds, or refuses it with a reason. A value out of range is rejected rather than clamped, because a setting silently adjusted is indistinguishable from one that had no effect. Booleans are refused for the numeric kinds on purpose: bool subclasses int in Python, so a size limit set to true would otherwise be accepted and silently mean one byte. 中文：按声明的类型与边界校验一个配置值，否则带理由拒绝。越界的值是拒绝而非钳制，因为被悄悄调整过的设置与从未生效的设置无从分辨。数值类型刻意拒绝布尔值：Python 里 bool 是 int 的子类，否则把大小上限设成 true 会被接受并悄悄意味着一个字节。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:239:defaults.text: The built-in settings, used when a repository supplies no file of its own. They reproduce the previously hardcoded constants exactly, so a repository with no configuration behaves identically to before the settings layer existed. 中文：内置默认设置，用于仓库没有自带配置文件的情况。它们精确复现了此前硬编码的常量，因此无配置文件的仓库与配置层出现之前行为完全一致。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:243:config_pat.text: Where a repository settings file lives: at the repository root, not inside the generated artifacts directory. That directory is ignored by version control and is what people delete to clear the cache, so anything authored there would be both uncommittable and destroyed by the obvious cleanup. 中文：仓库配置文件的位置——仓库根目录，而非生成物目录。后者被版本控制忽略，也是人们清缓存时直接删掉的目录；把手写内容放在那里既提交不了，又会被最自然的清理动作毁掉。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:247:load.text: Reads a repository settings file if it has one, and falls back to the built-in defaults if it does not. An unreadable file is an error naming the file, not a silent fallback. 中文：读取仓库的配置文件（若存在），否则回落到内置默认值。文件存在但读不了会报出点名该文件的错误，而不是静默回落。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:259:from_text.text: Parses settings text and validates every entry against the table, starting from the defaults. An unrecognised section or key is refused with a message listing what that section actually accepts, so a misspelling is caught at load time instead of appearing as a setting that mysteriously does nothing. 中文：以默认值为起点解析配置文本，并逐条对照设置表校验。不认识的段或键会被拒绝，消息里列出该段实际接受哪些键——拼写错误在加载时就被抓住，而不是表现为『设了但莫名其妙不起作用』。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:296:parse_toml.text: Reads settings text, using the standard library parser where it exists and the built-in fallback reader below it. The fallback exists so that supporting older interpreters does not require adding a runtime dependency, which would contradict what this package claims about having none. 中文：解析配置文本——标准库有解析器就用标准库，没有则用下面的内置回退读取器。回退读取器的存在是为了支持较老的解释器而不引入运行时依赖，否则就与本包『零依赖』的声明相矛盾。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:307:_strip_com.text: Removes a trailing comment from a line while respecting quotes, so a comment marker appearing inside a quoted value is left alone. Directory names and file suffixes are exactly the kind of value that might contain one. 中文：去掉行尾注释，但尊重引号——出现在引号内的注释符号原样保留。目录名与文件后缀恰恰是可能含有它的那类值。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:325:_parse_str.text: Reads a quoted text value, expanding the standard escape sequences including Unicode ones in the escaping form, and leaving the literal form untouched as its own rules require. An unsupported or truncated escape is refused with its line number rather than guessed at. 中文：读取带引号的文本值，展开标准转义序列（含 Unicode 转义），而字面量形式按其规则原样不动。不支持或被截断的转义会带着行号被拒绝，而不是靠猜。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:34:ConfigError.text: The error raised when a settings file cannot be applied as written. Raised rather than warned about, because a setting that is silently dropped looks from outside exactly like a setting that had no effect, leaving no way to tell a typo from a misunderstanding. 中文：配置文件无法按其字面生效时抛出的错误。选择抛错而非警告：被静默丢弃的设置从外部看和『设了但没效果』完全一样，用户无从区分拼写错误与理解错误。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:359:_parse_sca.text: Reads one single value: quoted text, a boolean, an integer in any supported base, a decimal or exponential number, or the non-finite float names. Anything else this reader cannot handle, such as a date or a multi-line form, is refused with its line number and a note of what is supported, rather than being misread. Recognising the non-finite names matters for agreement: omitting them once made this reader refuse a value the standard parser accepted, so the same file produced two different errors on two interpreters. 中文：读取单个值——带引号文本、布尔、任意进制整数、小数或指数形式的数、以及非有限浮点名。这个读取器处理不了的（日期、多行形式等）会带行号被拒绝并说明支持范围，而不是被误读。识别非有限浮点名对『两个读取器保持一致』很关键：遗漏它们曾让本读取器拒绝一个标准解析器接受的值，同一个文件在两种解释器上给出两种不同错误。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:392:_split_arr.text: Splits a bracketed list into its entries, respecting quotes and nesting so that a separator inside a quoted value or an inner list does not split it. An unclosed quote or bracket is refused with its line number. 中文：把方括号列表拆成条目，尊重引号与嵌套，使引号内或内层列表中的分隔符不会造成错误切分。未闭合的引号或括号会带行号被拒绝。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:423:parse_toml.text: The fallback settings reader used where the standard library parser is unavailable. It handles sections, keys, text, numbers, booleans and lists including those written across several lines, and refuses everything else with a line number instead of guessing. Its agreement with the real parser is checked case by case wherever the real one exists, so the two cannot drift apart in silence. 中文：标准库解析器不可用时使用的回退配置读取器。它处理段、键、文本、数字、布尔与列表（含跨行写法），其余一律带行号拒绝而不猜测。凡是有真解析器的环境都会逐例比对二者，确保它们不会悄悄产生分歧。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:44:Setting.text: One tunable value and everything known about it: its dotted name, its type, its default, its permitted range or closed set of members, whether changing it invalidates an existing index, and one line of help. Every consumer reads this table rather than restating the field list, so a value is named, defaulted and bounded in exactly one place. 中文：一个可调值及其全部已知信息：点分名称、类型、默认值、允许范围或封闭取值集、改动是否会作废现有索引、一行帮助文字。所有消费方都读这张表而不各自复述字段清单，因此一个值只在一处被命名、给默认、定边界。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:478:render_tem.text: Writes out a commented settings file listing every available setting at its default, with a line of help above each. Everything is commented out, so the file documents the whole surface without changing any behaviour merely by existing. 中文：生成一份带注释的配置文件，列出每一项设置及其默认值，每项上方一行帮助文字。全部处于注释状态，因此这个文件只是把可配置面写清楚，其存在本身不改变任何行为。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:504:render_val.text: Formats one value back into the settings file syntax, for the generated template and for writing a changed value back. 中文：把一个值格式化回配置文件语法，供生成模板与写回改动使用。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:514:parse_lite.text: Interprets one value given on the command line using exactly the same reader the file uses, so that setting something from a command and editing the file cannot disagree about what a value means, and both produce the same error text when it is wrong. 中文：用与配置文件完全相同的读取器解释命令行上给出的值，因此『用命令设置』与『手改文件』不会对某个值的含义产生分歧，出错时给出的也是同一段错误文字。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:525:update_fil.text: Changes one setting in place while preserving comments, ordering and every unrelated section. It replaces an existing assignment where there is one, uncomments the template line where there is one, and otherwise inserts under the right section, creating it if absent. Reading the file through a parser and writing it back out would be shorter and would silently delete every comment in it, including the explanations the generated template supplies. 中文：就地修改单项设置，同时保留注释、顺序与所有无关段落。已有赋值就替换，模板里的注释行就取消注释，都没有就插到对应段下（段不存在则新建）。用解析器读进来再写回去代码更短，但会静默删掉文件里的每一条注释，包括生成模板提供的全部说明。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:68:Setting.tab.text: The section a setting belongs to, taken from the part of its name before the dot. 中文：设置所属的段名，取自点号之前的部分。

src/ragyourcode/config.py:72:Setting.key.text: The bare key of a setting within its section, taken from the part of its name after the dot. 中文：设置在其段内的裸键名，取自点号之后的部分。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:125:Desc.name: DescriptionStore
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:125:Desc.text: The saved descriptions an agent has written, addressed by unit, each stored beside two digests of the code it describes: the whole source, and the source with its documentation removed. Kept at the repository root and meant to be committed, so one person's pass benefits everyone who clones. 中文：agent 写过的描述的持久存储，按单元寻址，每条附带所述代码的两个摘要——全文的，以及去掉文档之后的。放在仓库根目录并期望提交，使一个人写过的描述让所有克隆者受益。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:128:Desc.text: Returns the next units worth describing, offering those with no description at all before those needing a refresh. A unit retrieval is currently blind to is worth more than a re-write of one that already works, so an agent working under a budget spends its first batches where they matter most. 中文：返回下一批值得描述的单元，把『完全没有描述』的排在『需要刷新』的前面。检索目前完全够不到的单元，价值高于重写一条本来就能用的——预算有限的 agent 因此把最初几批花在最要紧的地方。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:140:Desc.name: DescriptionStore.classify
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:140:Desc.text: Sorts units into three groups: described and still valid, described but superseded because the code has since changed, and never described at all. Superseded is told apart from never-described by file and declaration name rather than by identifier, for the same reason applicability is: an identifier changes when the lines above it do. 中文：把单元分成三组——已描述且仍有效、已描述但因代码变动而失效、从未描述。『失效』与『从未描述』按文件与声明名区分而非按标识符，理由与生效判定相同：上方行数一变，标识符就变了。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:154:Desc.name: DescriptionStore._relocations
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:154:Desc.text: Finds saved text by file and code digest rather than by unit identifier, so a description follows the code it describes when that code merely moves. Identifiers embed the line a declaration starts on, so inserting a comment or an import near the top of a file gives everything below it a new identifier while changing none of their code; keyed on the identifier alone, every description in that file would be orphaned by an edit that touched nothing they describe. Indexed under both digests, so a unit that both moved and gained a docstring is still found. Two declarations in one file with byte-identical source and different saved text are ambiguous and resolve to nothing rather than to a guess. 中文：按文件与代码摘要查找已保存文字，而非按标识符，使代码仅仅位移时描述能跟着走。标识符里嵌着起始行号，在文件顶部插一条注释就会让其下所有声明换标识符而代码一字未改；只按标识符查找的话，一次没碰到任何被描述对象的编辑就会让整个文件的描述全部失联。两种摘要都建了索引，因此既位移又新增了 docstring 的单元仍能被找到。同一文件中源码逐字节相同、保存文字不同的两个声明属于歧义，解析为空而非靠猜。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:166:inde.text: Reads back the descriptions digest an index was published with, treating an index written before that field existed as having had no descriptions. Read as unknown instead, every older index would report itself permanently out of date over descriptions the repository does not have. 中文：读回索引发布时记录的描述摘要；此字段出现之前建的索引一律视为『当时没有任何描述』。若解读为『未知』，所有旧索引都会因为仓库根本没有的描述而永久自称过期。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:176:stor.text: Where the written descriptions live: at the repository root beside the settings file, not inside the generated artifacts directory, because they are authored work that must survive a cache clear and must be committable. 中文：已写描述的存放位置——仓库根目录、与配置文件并列，而不在生成物目录内：它们是手写成果，必须能提交、且必须在清缓存后依然存在。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:180:load.text: Reads the saved descriptions, treating a damaged or unreadable file as simply empty. This file is committed and will therefore meet merge conflicts and hand editing; a malformed one costs retrieval quality, which describing again recovers, whereas refusing to search until it is repaired would not be recoverable at all. 中文：读取已保存的描述，损坏或不可读的文件一律按空处理。这个文件会被提交，因而必然遇到合并冲突与手工编辑；格式坏了损失的是检索质量（重写一遍即可恢复），而『修好之前拒绝检索』则完全无法挽回。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:188:Desc.name: DescriptionStore.applicable
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:188:Desc.text: Selects only those saved descriptions whose code still matches what they were written about. The whole-source digest is tried first because it is a single hash and it hits for every unit whose file did not change, which with incremental indexing is nearly all of them; the documentation-excluded digest costs a parse and is computed only after the cheap one has missed, so that parse is paid once per genuinely changed unit rather than once per unit per run. Everything else is held back, because serving text that outlived the code it described would be a confident wrong answer. 中文：只挑出代码仍与所述内容相符的描述。先试全文摘要——它只是一次哈希，且对所有文件未改动的单元都命中，在增量索引下这几乎是全部；排除文档的摘要要付一次解析，只在廉价那个落空之后才算，因此解析成本按『真正变化的单元』计而非按『每次运行的每个单元』计。其余一律扣下：提供比所述代码活得更久的文字，就是给出一个自信的错误答案。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:247:Desc.name: DescriptionStore.put
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:247:Desc.text: Saves one written description together with the file it came from, its qualified name, and two digests of the code: the whole source, and the source with documentation excluded. The second is what keeps the entry alive when a docstring is added, including one promoted from this very description. An entry written before that field existed keeps working through the first alone, so no store needs migrating. 中文：保存一条写好的描述，连同所在文件、限定名，以及代码的两个摘要——全文的，与排除文档的。后者使得新增 docstring（包括从这条描述本身提升出去的那段）不会让条目失效。此字段出现之前写的条目仅凭前者也照常工作，因此没有任何存储需要迁移。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:260:Desc.name: DescriptionStore.save
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:260:Desc.text: Writes the store to disk atomically, filling in the documentation-excluded digest for any entry that lacks one and currently matches, and dropping entries for units that no longer exist when given the full list of what does. Filling in happens here because the full unit list is at hand and a matching entry proves the source is unchanged, so the derived digest is certainly right; the store upgrades itself on any write rather than needing a migration somebody has to remember. An entry is kept when its identifier is still live or its code is, because a declaration that merely moved has a new identifier and the same digest. 中文：原子地写盘；顺手为缺少『排除文档摘要』且当前仍匹配的条目补上该值；在拿到完整现存单元清单时清除已不存在单元的条目。补值放在这里，是因为完整清单就在手边，而条目仍匹配本身就证明源码未变、推导出的摘要必定正确——存储在任何一次写入时自我升级，无需谁记得去跑迁移。条目只要标识符还在、或其代码还在就予以保留，因为仅仅位移的声明有新标识符却是同一摘要。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:42:sourc.text: A short digest of the exact code text a description was written about, so a description can never be applied to code it does not describe. When the code changes the digest stops matching and the description is set aside rather than served. 中文：对『描述所针对的那段代码文本』取短摘要，使描述永远不会被套用到它没有描述过的代码上。代码一变摘要就不再匹配，描述随即被搁置而非继续提供。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:47:guida.text: The brief handed to an agent with every batch of units awaiting description. It states plainly that matching is by shared words, so the agent is asked for the words a person would search by: what the unit is for in domain terms, the operation it performs, the failure it handles, and the obvious synonyms for each. It also forbids restating the signature and forbids describing behaviour the source does not show. Returned through the protocol rather than living only in documentation, so any host gets the same brief and it cannot drift from the settings that shape it. 中文：随每批待描述单元交给 agent 的说明。它直白地讲明匹配靠共享词，因此要求写『人会用来搜索的词』：业务含义、执行的操作、处理的故障，以及各自的常见同义说法；同时禁止复述签名、禁止描述源码未展示的行为。它通过协议返回而非只写在文档里，使任何宿主都拿到同一份说明，且不会与塑造它的设置脱节。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:49:code_.name: code_only
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:49:code_.text: A unit's source with all of its own documentation removed, used for the digest that decides whether a stored description still applies. Documentation is not code: adding or rewriting a docstring changes nothing about what a function does, so invalidating a description over it is the guard firing on a change that cannot make the description wrong. It fired hardest on the one operation meant to help — promoting a description into the source inserts that very description, the digest changes, and the entry is dropped along with whatever part of the text was not promoted. Every docstring in the span is removed, not only the leading one, because a class contains its methods. 中文：把一个单元的源码去掉其中全部文档后用于摘要计算，该摘要决定已存描述是否仍然适用。文档不是代码：增改 docstring 不改变函数做什么，因此据此判定描述失效，等于守卫对着一个不可能使描述出错的变化开火。它最严重的一次误伤恰恰发生在本该帮忙的操作上——把描述提升进源码，插进去的正是这段描述自己，摘要一变条目就被丢弃，连同没被提升的那半段文字。剥离的是跨度内的全部 docstring 而非只有开头那一段，因为类的跨度包含它的方法。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:76:Descr.text: A digest of all the written text, so an index can tell when the descriptions it was built from have changed. Importing descriptions touches no source file, so nothing the usual freshness check tracks would move, and the index would go on serving the previous wording until somebody happened to rebuild. An empty store deliberately digests to nothing, so an index written before this field existed is not mistaken for one built from descriptions it never had. 中文：对全部已写文本取摘要，让索引能察觉『它所依据的描述已经变了』。导入描述不触碰任何源文件，常规新鲜度检查追踪的东西都没动，索引会一直提供旧措辞直到有人恰好重建。空存储刻意摘要为空，使此字段出现之前建的索引不会被误认为『依据了它从未有过的描述』。

src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:98:code_.name: code_key
src/ragyourcode/descriptions.py:98:code_.text: Digest of a unit's code with its documentation excluded, the value a stored description is anchored to when the cheap whole-source digest no longer matches. 中文：排除文档之后的代码摘要；当廉价的全文摘要不再匹配时，已存描述就锚定到这个值上。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:111:render_c.name: render_comment
src/ragyourcode/document.py:111:render_c.text: Renders text as a documentation comment in one language's own convention: a block opened and closed for the C family, a repeated line prefix for Rust, Go, Ruby and shell. Indentation matches the declaration it will sit above. 中文：按某种语言自身的约定把文字渲染成文档注释——C 家族用成对的块注释，Rust、Go、Ruby、shell 用重复的行前缀。缩进与它将要贴在其上方的声明保持一致。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:123:render_d.name: render_docstring
src/ragyourcode/document.py:123:render_d.text: Renders text as a Python docstring, collapsed onto one line when it fits and spread across several when it does not. Python is the exception among the supported languages: its documentation goes inside the body rather than above the declaration. 中文：把文字渲染成 Python docstring，放得下就压成一行，放不下就分成多行。Python 是受支持语言中的例外：它的文档写在函数体内部，而不是声明上方。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:131:_python_.name: _python_body_start
src/ragyourcode/document.py:131:_python_.text: Finds where a docstring would go and at what indentation, through the syntax tree rather than by looking for a trailing colon: a signature can span several lines and carry colons inside its annotations, so scanning text for the end of the declaration would land in the wrong place. 中文：通过语法树找出 docstring 该插在哪一行、缩进多少，而不是靠找行尾冒号——签名可能跨多行、注解里也有冒号，用文本扫描判断声明结束会落错位置。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:153:plan.name: plan
src/ragyourcode/document.py:153:plan.text: Works out which declarations would gain a documentation comment and what it would say. Skips anything the author already documented, because their words outrank an agent's and are already indexed; skips anything with no stored description; skips a language whose convention is unknown. Whether a declaration is already documented is asked of the parser on a fresh parse rather than read off the applied description, because an authored description replaces the generated sentence outright and testing that sentence made thoroughly documented functions read as undocumented. 中文：算出哪些声明会获得文档注释、内容是什么。跳过作者已经写过文档的（作者的话优先于 agent 的，而且已经被索引）、没有已存描述的、以及约定未知的语言。『是否已有文档』这一问题是对解析器重新解析后提出的，而不是从已应用的描述里读——authored 描述会整个替换生成的句子，拿那句话判断会让文档齐全的函数显示为无文档。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:208:render_p.name: render_patch
src/ragyourcode/document.py:208:render_p.text: Turns planned insertions into a unified diff a person can read before anything touches their files. Line endings are preserved as found and the file is read without newline translation, because rewriting a repository CRLF into LF would be a change nobody asked for buried inside a change they did. Several insertions in one file are applied from the bottom up so earlier ones do not shift later line numbers. 中文：把计划好的插入变成一份人可以先读再决定的统一 diff，源文件在此之前不被触碰。行尾按原样保留、读取时不做换行转换，因为把仓库的 CRLF 改写成 LF，等于在一个人要求的改动里夹带一个他没要求的改动。同一文件里的多处插入自下而上应用，使先插入的不会移动后插入的行号。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:229:summaris.name: summarise
src/ragyourcode/document.py:229:summaris.text: Counts what a promotion run would do: how many declarations already carry the author's own documentation, how many have a stored description, how many insertions the patch contains, and whether any supported language lacks a documentation convention here. 中文：统计一次促成运行会做什么：多少声明已经带有作者自己的文档、多少有已存描述、补丁包含多少处插入，以及是否存在受支持却没有文档约定的语言。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:67:Insertion.name: Insertion
src/ragyourcode/document.py:67:Insertion.text: One documentation comment waiting to be added, addressed by the line it goes before rather than by a character offset, so several additions to one file can be applied from the bottom upward without shifting each other. 中文：一条待添加的文档注释，按『插在哪一行之前』定位而非字符偏移，因此同一文件的多处插入可以自下而上应用而互不推移行号。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:76:source_ha.name: source_half
src/ragyourcode/document.py:76:source_ha.text: The part of a description meant for somebody reading the code. Descriptions are written for retrieval and may carry more than one language, because a query only reaches a unit whose indexed text shares its words; source is read by people, so the promoted half stops at the first Chinese character. A description written entirely in Chinese has no such half and is promoted whole rather than dropped. Only whitespace is trimmed: an earlier version also stripped trailing punctuation and ate the full stop off every promoted sentence. 中文：描述中面向代码阅读者的那一半。描述是为检索写的、可能含多种语言（查询只能命中索引文本与之共词的单元），而源码是给人读的，所以提升的部分止于第一个汉字。全中文的描述没有这一半，整条提升而非丢弃。只裁剪空白：早先的版本连尾部标点一起剥，把每句话的句号都吃掉了。

src/ragyourcode/document.py:97:_wrap.name: _wrap
src/ragyourcode/document.py:97:_wrap.text: Breaks a paragraph into lines that fit a comment's available width, accounting for the indentation and the marker each line carries. 中文：把一段文字折成适合注释可用宽度的行，计入缩进与每行携带的标记长度。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:105:LocalE.name: LocalEmbedder.__init__
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:105:LocalE.text: Fixes the vector width this embedder will produce, and records that its provider is the local hash and that it has no model. Those two values go into what an index publishes about itself, which is how a later run tells vectors of one scheme from another. 中文：确定该嵌入器将产出的向量宽度，并记录其 provider 为本地哈希、无模型。这两个值会进入索引对自身的记录，后续运行正是据此分辨不同方案产出的向量。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:110:LocalE.name: LocalEmbedder.one
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:110:LocalE.text: One text's vector, computed here and now with no network. This is the call a query goes through, and it exists on both embedders so a query never has to know which one it is talking to. 中文：一段文本的向量，就地计算、不走网络。查询走的就是这个调用；两种嵌入器都有它，因此查询无需知道自己面对的是哪一种。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:113:LocalE.name: LocalEmbedder.many
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:113:LocalE.text: Vectors for a batch, which for the local hash is simply each in turn: there is no round trip to amortise. The method exists so the indexer can treat both embedders the same way, and so batching becomes the provider's concern rather than the caller's. 中文：一批文本的向量；对本地哈希而言就是逐个计算，没有往返可以摊薄。这个方法存在，是为了让索引器以同样的方式对待两种嵌入器，把成批处理变成 provider 自己的事而非调用方的事。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:117:LocalE.name: LocalEmbedder.metadata
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:117:LocalE.text: What an index should record about how its vectors were made: the scheme, the version and the width. Stored so that vectors built by an incompatible scheme are detected and discarded instead of silently mixed in. 中文：索引应当记录的、关于其向量如何产生的信息：方案、版本、宽度。存下来是为了让不兼容方案产出的向量被检测出并丢弃，而不是被悄悄混入。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:121:Remote.name: RemoteEmbedder
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:121:Remote.text: Vectors from a model somebody else runs, reached over an OpenAI-compatible API that may be a vendor or a server on localhost. Being semantic is what earns it the right to add candidates rather than only reorder them: it is the only mechanism that can reach a unit sharing no word with the question. Requests are batched, and a repository whose vectors were all reused costs nothing. 中文：向量来自别人运行的模型，经 OpenAI 兼容接口取得，对端可以是厂商也可以是本机服务。携带语义正是它有资格新增候选而不仅是重排的原因：它是唯一能够到与问题零共享词的单元的机制。请求成批发出；向量全部复用的仓库不产生任何开销。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:137:Remote.name: RemoteEmbedder.__init__
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:137:Remote.text: Refuses an incomplete or unsafe configuration before any request is made: an endpoint or model left empty is named as the setting that is missing, and a credential bound for a cleartext connection to anything but this machine is rejected outright. Failing here rather than mid-build is the difference between a clear message and a half-written index. 中文：在发出任何请求之前拒绝不完整或不安全的配置：端点或模型为空时点名缺的是哪一项设置；凭证若要走明文连接发往本机以外，直接拒绝。在此处失败而不是构建到一半失败，是清晰报错与半成品索引之间的差别。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:147:Remote.name: RemoteEmbedder.one
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:147:Remote.text: One text's vector, fetched as a batch of one. A query takes this path, which is why the query and the units it will be compared against are guaranteed to come from the same model. 中文：一段文本的向量，按只有一条的批次取回。查询走的就是这条路径，这正是查询与它将被比对的那些单元一定同源于同一个模型的原因。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:150:Remote.name: RemoteEmbedder.many
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:150:Remote.text: Vectors for many texts, split into requests of the configured size. Batching is the whole reason this method exists rather than a loop over the single-text call: against a remote endpoint a round trip per unit turns a two-second index into an unusable one. 中文：多段文本的向量，按配置的批量大小切分成若干请求。成批处理正是这个方法存在、而非对单条调用做循环的全部理由：面对远端端点，每个单元一个往返会把两秒的索引变成不可用的东西。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:167:Remote.name: RemoteEmbedder.metadata
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:167:Remote.text: What an index records about vectors that came from a model somebody else runs: the provider, the version, the width and the model name. The model name is there for the same reason the provider is — two models behind one endpoint are two vector spaces, and a change to either has to discard the stored vectors rather than mix them. 中文：索引对来自他人所运行模型的向量所记录的信息：provider、版本、宽度、模型名。模型名在内的理由与 provider 相同——同一端点后面的两个模型是两个向量空间，任一改变都必须丢弃已存向量而不是把它们混在一起。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:171:embedd.name: embedder
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:171:embedd.text: Returns whichever embedder a repository's settings ask for. The credential is read from the environment and the settings file holds only the variable's name, because every other setting is meant to be committed so that everyone who clones can see what shaped the index, and a credential is the one value with exactly the opposite requirement. That is why this is not the environment-variable layer the configuration module deliberately does not have. 中文：按仓库设置返回相应的嵌入器。凭证从环境变量读取，配置文件里只存变量名——因为其余每一项设置都意在提交，好让所有克隆者看清是什么塑造了这个索引，而凭证恰恰是唯一要求相反的值。这也正是它并非配置模块刻意不设的那个环境变量层的原因。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:25:embeddi.name: embedding_metadata
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:25:embeddi.text: Reports which scheme, which model and which version produced an index and how wide its vectors are, stored inside the index so vectors from an incompatible scheme are detected and discarded rather than silently mixed in. The model name is part of it for the same reason the provider is: two models behind one endpoint occupy different vector spaces. 中文：报告是哪套方案、哪个模型、哪个版本产出了这个索引，以及向量多宽；该信息存进索引，使来自不兼容方案的向量被检测出并丢弃，而不是被悄悄混入。模型名之所以在内，理由与 provider 相同：同一端点后面的两个模型占据不同的向量空间。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:26:tokeniz.text: Splits text into the lowercase terms that both indexing and querying match on: identifiers, numbers, and runs of Chinese characters. Chinese is additionally broken into overlapping two-character pieces, because whole-phrase matching would almost never hit; this is why a Chinese query can reach a unit whose indexed text contains Chinese. 中文：把文本切成索引与查询共用的小写词项——标识符、数字、连续汉字。汉字额外切成相邻二字组，否则整句匹配几乎永远落空；这也是中文查询能命中含中文索引文本的机制。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:36:_bucket.text: Hashes one term into a stable slot number using BLAKE2b, so the same word always lands in the same position on any machine and any run. Determinism is the point: it is what makes an index reproducible without a network or a model. 中文：用 BLAKE2b 把一个词哈希成稳定的槽位号，同一个词在任何机器、任何一次运行都落在同一位置。确定性是关键——它让索引无需联网、无需模型即可复现。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:41:embed.text: Turns text into a fixed-width numeric vector by the hashing trick: each term is hashed to a slot and added with a hash-derived sign, then the vector is normalised to unit length. There is no trained model and no semantic knowledge here. Cosine between two of these vectors measures shared words, so texts with no word in common score exactly zero however close their meanings. A width below the floor is refused because collisions would dominate. 中文：用哈希技巧把文本变成定宽数值向量——每个词哈希到一个槽位并按符号累加，最后归一化。这里没有训练过的模型、没有语义知识：余弦度量的是共享词，毫无共词的两段文本无论意思多接近都精确得零。维度低于下限会被拒绝，因为碰撞过重。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:57:cosine.text: Similarity between two already-normalised vectors, as a plain dot product. Returns zero rather than raising when either side is empty or the widths disagree, which is how an index whose vectors were built at a different width degrades quietly to word-overlap-only ranking instead of failing loudly. 中文：两个已归一化向量的相似度，即点积。任一为空或维度不一致时返回零而非抛错——这也是为什么用不同维度建的旧向量只会静默退化成纯词面排序，而不会报错。

src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:93:LocalEm.name: LocalEmbedder
src/ragyourcode/embeddings.py:93:LocalEm.text: The default embedder: a signed feature hash computed here, offline, with no dependency and no socket. That it carries no semantics is the load-bearing fact about it -- cosine over these vectors measures shared tokens, so a synonym pair and an unrelated pair are indistinguishable at exactly 0.0000. Retrieval therefore treats it as a tie-breaker among units the words already found, and never lets it decide what is found. 中文：默认嵌入器：本地计算的带符号特征哈希，离线、零依赖、不开 socket。它不携带语义这一点才是关于它最要紧的事实——这些向量之间的余弦度量的是共享词，因此同义词对与无关词对在 0.0000 处无从分辨。所以检索只把它当作已由词面找到的单元之间的平局裁决者，绝不让它决定什么被找到。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:112:build_graph.text: Derives the whole relationship graph from parsed units: containment from declared parents, calls from recorded references, imports from module names. Every edge is capped and conservative. An ambiguous reference that could mean several units produces no edge at all, a per-unit budget stops one heavily-connected function from flooding the graph, and a module reference only becomes an edge when the target has a small unambiguous surface. Omitting an uncertain relationship is preferred to inventing one. 中文：从解析出的单元推导整张关系图：包含关系来自声明的父节点，调用来自记录的引用，导入来自模块名。每条边都保守且有上限：歧义引用（可能指向多个单元）不产生任何边；每单元的边数预算防止高连接函数淹没图；模块引用只在目标面很小且无歧义时才成边。宁可省略不确定的关系，也不凭空造一条。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:155:graph_from_.text: Rebuilds the relationship graph from what an index stored, skipping any entry whose shape it does not recognise. A scanned repository can ship its own index file, so a malformed entry must be ignored rather than trusted. 中文：从索引中存储的内容重建关系图，跳过任何形状不合的条目。被扫描的仓库可能自带索引文件，因此格式错误的条目必须忽略而非信任。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:19:CodeEdge.text: One directed relationship between two code units, carrying its kind and a human-readable label. Kinds are deliberately few and conservative: one unit calls another, imports it, or contains it. 中文：两个代码单元之间的一条有向关系，带类型与可读标签。类型刻意保持极少且保守：调用、导入、包含。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:208:graph_searc.name: graph_search
src/ragyourcode/graph.py:208:graph_searc.text: Retrieves by words first, then follows calls, imports and containment outward from what was found. When the seeds were withheld for want of evidence there is nothing to expand, and that matters more than it sounds: walking outward from a guess turns one unsupported result into a whole connected neighbourhood of them, each carrying an edge chain that makes it look better evidenced than the guess it came from. 中文：先按词面检索，再从命中项沿调用、导入与包含关系向外走。当种子因证据不足而被扣下时，就没有东西可扩展了——这件事比听起来重要：从一个猜测向外走，会把一个没有依据的结果变成一整片彼此相连的结果，而且每一个都带着边链，看上去比它出身的那个猜测更有据可依。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:25:CodeEdge.to_.text: Serialises one relationship for storage inside the index or for an agent reply. 中文：把一条关系序列化，供写入索引或应答 agent。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:29:CodeGraph.text: The directed relationship graph over indexed units, with bounded neighbourhood traversal. It answers navigation questions retrieval alone cannot: what calls this, what does this call, what contains it. Every answer carries the exact path of edges that reached it. 中文：建立在已索引单元之上的有向关系图，支持有界邻域遍历。它回答纯检索答不了的导航问题：谁调用了它、它调用了谁、谁包含它。每个答案都附带到达它的确切边路径。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:32:CodeGraph.__.text: Builds the forward and backward adjacency tables, keeping only relationships whose two endpoints both exist in this index. An edge pointing at something that is not indexed is dropped rather than kept as a dangling reference. 中文：建立正向与反向邻接表，只保留两端都存在于本索引中的关系。指向未索引对象的边直接丢弃，不留悬空引用。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:42:CodeGraph.ne.text: Walks outward from one unit to find related code within a hop limit, following relationships forward, backward or both. Each unit is visited once, and every result comes back with the full chain of edges that reached it so the connection can be checked rather than trusted. 中文：从一个单元向外走，在跳数上限内找出相关代码，可沿正向、反向或双向。每个单元只访问一次，每条结果都带回到达它的完整边链，使连接可核查而非只能相信。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:69:CodeGraph.to.text: Serialises the whole relationship graph for storage inside the index. 中文：把整张关系图序列化，写入索引存储。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:73:_name_indexe.text: Builds two lookup tables used to resolve references: identifier to the units declaring it, and module filename to the units it defines. The second is what lets a reference be recognised as belonging to this repository rather than to an installed library. 中文：建立两张用于解析引用的查找表——标识符到声明它的单元、模块文件名到它定义的单元。后者用于判断一个引用属于本仓库还是外部库。

src/ragyourcode/graph.py:85:_call_target.text: Resolves a recorded function reference to the local units it actually names. An exact match on the recorded text always wins. Matching only the last dotted segment is a guess, and is allowed only when the leading part is attributable to this repository, meaning a receiver or a module some file here defines. Unrestricted, that guess gave a standard-library path an edge into an unrelated local function of the same short name; foreign prefixes now resolve to nothing, which is what this module promises. 中文：把记录下来的调用文本解析成本地单元。精确匹配优先。只匹配最后一段是猜测，仅当前缀可归属于本仓库（接收者，或本地某文件定义的模块）时才允许。不加限制时，这种猜测曾让一个标准库路径连到同名的本地函数上；现在外部前缀一律解析为空，这正是本模块承诺的『解析不出就省略，而不是猜』。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:101:iter_sour.text: Walks a repository and yields the files that count as source, skipping configured directories, hidden ones, unsupported suffixes, anything above the size cap, and symbolic links. Links are skipped so a link pointing outside the repository cannot pull foreign files into the index. 中文：遍历仓库并产出算作源码的文件，跳过配置指定的目录、隐藏目录、不支持的后缀、超过大小上限的文件，以及符号链接。跳过链接是为了防止指向仓库之外的链接把外部文件拉进索引。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:110:index_bui.name: index_build_fingerprint
src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:110:index_bui.text: Reads back the digest an index was published with. An index written before this field existed returns nothing, which matches no current value and so forces one full rebuild on upgrade. That is the correct reading rather than a cost to avoid: such an index was built by a different parser, and its units are exactly what a rebuild exists for. 中文：读回索引发布时记录的digest。此字段出现之前建的索引返回空，与任何当前值都不匹配，因此升级后强制一次全量重建——这不是要规避的代价而是正确解读：那种索引是另一个解析器建的，它的单元正是重建要处理的对象。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:121:Repositor.text: One reading of the repository taken in a single pass, shared by parsing and by publication. Hashing in a second pass let a save landing between the two record a file new content hash beside units parsed from its old content; the index then reported itself fresh, and every later incremental run reused the outdated units permanently. Taking the reading once removes that window rather than narrowing it, and cut a run from four directory walks to one. 中文：一次遍历中取得的仓库快照，供解析与发布共用。分两次遍历时，落在两次之间的一次保存会让索引记下文件的新哈希、旁边却是从旧内容解析出的单元；此后索引自称新鲜，而每一次增量运行都永久复用这批过时单元。一次取样是消除这个窗口而非缩小它，同时把一次运行的目录遍历从四次降到一次。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:137:Repositor.text: A single digest standing for the whole repository content at the moment it was read. 中文：代表快照时刻整个仓库内容的单一摘要。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:141:snapshot_.text: Reads, hashes and measures every source file in one pass. A file that vanished or became unreadable between being listed and being read is simply absent from the reading, because recording a half-read entry would reintroduce exactly the mismatch this snapshot exists to prevent. 中文：一次遍历中读取、哈希并测量每个源文件。在列出与读取之间消失或变得不可读的文件，直接不出现在这次快照里——记下一个读了一半的条目，等于把这份快照本来要消灭的不一致又请回来。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:163:file_fing.text: The content hash of every source file, used to decide which files can be reused unchanged on the next run. 中文：每个源文件的内容哈希，用于判断下次运行时哪些文件可以原样复用。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:167:file_stat.text: Collects only the size and modification time of every source file, deliberately without hashing anything. The freshness check asks whether anything moved many times per session and needs no content guarantee; routing it through the full hashing pass measured two and a half times slower on a large repository. 中文：只收集每个源文件的大小与修改时间，刻意不做任何哈希。新鲜度检查每次会话要问很多遍、且不需要内容一致性保证；把它接到全量哈希那条路上，在大仓库上实测慢了两倍半。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:187:_assign_g.text: Gives every unit a repository-wide number, keeping the number a unit already had so that references written down in an earlier session still point at the same code. New units take the lowest numbers not already in use. 中文：给每个单元分配一个仓库范围内的编号，并保留单元原有的编号，使早先会话里记下的引用仍指向同一段代码。新单元取尚未被占用的最小编号。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:264:build_uni.name: build_units
src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:264:build_uni.text: Parses a repository into units, reusing unchanged files and keeping serial numbers stable, then gives every unit that needs one a vector. Reuse stops when the authored text moved, and for one direction only: the apply step only ever sets text, so adding and changing a description took effect while deleting one did nothing at all. Only re-parsing recovers the generated sentence; vectors are then carried across by identity on the text they were computed from, so a unit whose own text did not move costs no embedding request. 中文：把仓库解析成单元，复用未变动的文件并让编号保持稳定，再给每个需要的单元算向量。人写的文字一旦变动就停止复用，而问题只出在一个方向：应用那一步只会「设置」文字，因此加描述、改描述都生效，唯独删描述什么也没做。只有重新解析才能恢复生成的句子；随后向量按「算它时所依据的文本是否相同」搬运，因此自身文本没动的单元一个嵌入请求都不花。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:269:fingerpri.text: A single digest standing for the whole repository content right now, used to tell a published index apart from the current state. 中文：代表仓库当前全部内容的单一摘要，用于区分已发布索引与当前状态。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:273:_fingerpr.text: Combines per-file hashes into one repository-wide digest in a fixed order, so the same content always yields the same value. 中文：按固定顺序把逐文件哈希合成一个仓库级摘要，相同内容永远得到相同值。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:31:_resolve.text: Falls back to the repository own settings when a caller supplies none, so a program using this as a library and the same operation run from the command line cannot disagree about which files count as source. 中文：调用方未提供设置时回落到仓库自己的配置，使『作为库调用』与『命令行运行同一操作』不会对『哪些文件算源码』产生分歧。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:344:_remove_s.text: Deletes this index own outdated vector side files. Which files to remove is worked out from the naming scheme publication itself uses, and never from a path read back out of the index being replaced. A scanned repository can ship its own index file, so trusting a path stored inside one turned publishing into deleting an arbitrary file in the tree. Working it out instead also reclaims side files orphaned by an earlier run whose index was unreadable, and a file that cannot be removed is left alone since nothing points at it. 中文：删除本索引自己过期的向量旁文件。删哪些是按发布流程自身的命名规则推算出来的，绝不取自被替换索引里读到的路径——被扫描的仓库可以自带索引文件，信任其中存储的路径会把『发布』变成『删除目录树里的任意文件』。改用推算还能回收更早一次运行遗留的孤儿旁文件；删不掉的文件直接放着，因为没有任何索引指向它。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:353:write_ind.name: write_index
src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:353:write_ind.text: Publishes an index atomically: the vector data goes to a content-addressed side file first, then the readable metadata is swapped into place in one move, so a reader never sees a half-written index. What it records includes who computed the vectors and with which model, which is what lets a later run tell a stale index apart from an index of a different vector space. 中文：原子地发布索引：向量数据先写入按内容寻址的旁挂文件，随后可读的元数据一次性换入，读者因此永远看不到写到一半的索引。它记录的内容包含向量由谁计算、用的哪个模型——正是这一点让后续运行能分辨「过时的索引」与「另一个向量空间的索引」。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:375:read_inde.text: Loads a published index back into memory, attaching vectors from the compact side file when one is used. Everything about that side file is verified before it is trusted: it must sit inside the index directory, its declared width must be within bounds, and its length must match the number of units. Any failure degrades to metadata without vectors and says so explicitly, rather than raising, so a damaged side file costs ranking quality instead of availability. 中文：把已发布的索引读回内存，使用紧凑旁文件时顺带挂上向量。旁文件在被信任之前逐项校验：必须位于索引目录内、声明的维度必须在合理范围、长度必须与单元数吻合。任何一项不过就降级为『只有元数据、没有向量』并明确标注，而不是抛错——旁文件损坏付出的是排序质量而非可用性。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:41:StaleMonit.name: StaleMonitor
src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:41:StaleMonit.text: Answers whether an index still describes the repository, rate-limited so an agent can ask many times a second without re-walking the tree each time. 中文：回答『索引是否仍然描述着当前仓库』，带频率限制，使 agent 每秒问很多次也不会每次都重走一遍目录树。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:44:StaleMonit.name: StaleMonitor.__init__
src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:44:StaleMonit.text: Prepares the freshness check and settles up front whether the rules that built the index have changed since it was published. Neither the settings file, nor the written descriptions, nor the parser is itself an indexed source file, so no amount of walking the tree could notice a change in any of them: different suffixes or size caps mean the index describes a different set of files, a different parser means its units were carved out differently, and different descriptions mean it serves wording nobody wrote any more. All of them make it out of date regardless of what the file scan reports. 中文：准备新鲜度检查，并预先判定建出这个索引的规则自发布以来是否改变。配置文件、已写描述、解析器，三者本身都不是被索引的源文件，因此再怎么遍历目录树也发现不了它们的变化：后缀或大小上限不同意味着索引描述的是另一批文件，解析器不同意味着单元的切分方式变了，描述不同意味着它提供的是无人再写过的措辞。无论文件扫描报告什么，这三者都使索引过期。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:69:StaleMonit.text: Reports whether anything has changed, comparing recorded file sizes and modification times against the repository as it now is, and answering from the previous result when asked again within the rate-limit window. A changed authored input short-circuits to out of date immediately. A directory that cannot be read is treated as changed, since not knowing is not the same as knowing nothing moved. 中文：报告是否有变化——把记录下的文件大小与修改时间与当前仓库比对；在限流窗口内再次询问则复用上次结果。手写输入有变时直接短路判定为过期。目录读不了一律当作有变化：『不知道』不等于『确定没动』。

src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:89:build_fing.name: build_fingerprint
src/ragyourcode/indexer.py:89:build_fing.text: A digest of everything that decides what a code unit is: the settings that choose which files are read and how wide a vector is, and the parser that decides what counts as a declaration and where it ends. Units produced under a different configuration or a different parser are not stale units of this repository, they are units of something else, and both cases call for discarding them. Keeping the two as separate fields would mean two comparisons and two chances to add a third input and forget one. 中文：把『决定一个代码单元是什么』的全部因素摘成一个digest——选哪些文件、向量多宽的设置，加上判定什么算声明、声明到哪结束的解析器。在不同配置或不同解析器下产出的单元不是本仓库的陈旧单元，而是另一个东西的单元，两种情况都该整体丢弃。分成两个字段就意味着两次比较，也就多一次『加了第三个输入却忘了它』的机会。

src/ragyourcode/models.py:105:SearchResu.name: SearchResult
src/ragyourcode/models.py:105:SearchResu.text: One retrieved unit together with why it was retrieved: how well it scored, which query words actually matched, and for graph expansion the chain of edges that led to it. The evidence is the point -- a result you cannot explain is a result you should not act on, and an agent that can see the matched words can tell a real hit from the fallback that matched nothing. 中文：一个被检索到的单元，连同它为什么被检索到：得分多少、真正命中了查询里的哪些词、以及图扩展时到达它的那条边链。证据才是重点——解释不了的结果就是不该照做的结果，而能看到命中词的 agent 才分得清真命中与什么都没匹配上的兜底。

src/ragyourcode/models.py:116:SearchResu.name: SearchResult.to_dict
src/ragyourcode/models.py:116:SearchResu.text: Writes a result out for an agent: where the unit is, what it is called, why it matched and how well -- but not its source. A result is navigation evidence; the code arrives once in the reply budgeted context block, and an agent wanting more opens the cited file. Bounding each emitter separately would have left the next one free to overrun, whereas a result that has no source cannot carry it twice. 中文：把一条结果写给 agent：单元在哪、叫什么、为何命中、命中得多好——但不含源码。结果是导航证据；代码只在回复受预算约束的上下文块里出现一次，想要更多的 agent 去打开被引用的文件。逐个发射点分别设限，只会让下一个发射点继续超发；而一条不含源码的结果，从构造上就无法把它带第二遍。

src/ragyourcode/models.py:11:CodeUnit.name: CodeUnit
src/ragyourcode/models.py:11:CodeUnit.text: One retrievable piece of a codebase and everything known about it: where it lives, what it is called, what it declares, what it calls and imports, what it is for, and the exact lines it occupies. It is the contract every stage agrees on -- the parser produces it, ranking consumes it, the agent protocol serialises it -- which is why parser rewrites and scoring rewrites have both landed underneath it without moving it. 中文：代码库中一个可被检索的片段，及其全部已知信息：位于何处、叫什么、声明了什么、调用与导入了什么、用来做什么、精确占据哪些行。它是各阶段共同遵守的契约——解析器产出它、排序消费它、agent 协议序列化它——所以解析器重写与打分重写都能在它之下完成而不动它。

src/ragyourcode/models.py:32:CodeUnit.se.name: CodeUnit.searchable_fields
src/ragyourcode/models.py:32:CodeUnit.se.text: Everything retrieval may match, kept apart by where the author wrote it. Where a word appears is itself evidence of what it means: a term in a declaration name is what the author decided to call the thing, while the same term deep in a body is a passing mention. Flattened into one blob, a long function outranks the function actually named after the query purely by owning more words. 中文：检索允许匹配的全部文本，按作者把它写在哪里分开保存。词出现的位置本身就是它有多重要的证据：出现在声明名字里的词是作者对这个东西的命名，同一个词埋在函数体深处则只是顺带一提。压成一整块之后，一个长函数仅凭词多就能压过真正以查询命名的那个函数。

src/ragyourcode/models.py:55:CodeUnit.se.name: CodeUnit.searchable_text
src/ragyourcode/models.py:55:CodeUnit.se.text: Every searchable field as one block, for callers that want the words without caring where they came from -- a unit is embedded from this. Derived from the fields rather than rebuilt beside them, so a field added for ranking cannot go missing from the text that gets embedded. 中文：把全部可检索字段合成一块，供那些只要词、不关心词来自哪里的调用方使用——单元的向量就由它生成。它由字段派生而非另起炉灶重建，因此为排序新增的字段不会从被嵌入的文本里漏掉。

src/ragyourcode/models.py:64:CodeUnit.to.name: CodeUnit.to_dict
src/ragyourcode/models.py:64:CodeUnit.to.text: Writes a unit out for storage or for a reply, with two things optional: the vector, which is an internal ranking detail an agent cannot act on, and the source, which a reply already carries once in its budgeted context block. Repeating the source per result is what let a single answer run to five times its stated budget. 中文：把一个单元写出，用于存储或回复，其中两样可选：向量是排序的内部细节，agent 拿它做不了任何事；源码则已经在回复受预算约束的上下文块里出现过一次。每条结果各带一份源码，正是让一次回答涨到声称预算五倍的原因。

src/ragyourcode/models.py:66:CodeUnit.fr.text: Rebuilds a unit from its stored dictionary form when an index is loaded back from disk. 中文：从磁盘读回索引时，把存储的字典形式还原成单元对象。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:182:_line_offs.text: Computes where each line begins in the source, counting only the line breaks Python itself counts. The obvious library call also breaks on form feed, vertical tab and several Unicode separators that the Python tokenizer does not, so a single form feed inside a string literal shifted every later position: one unit was truncated mid-literal and the next lost its whole body. 中文：计算每行在源码中的起始位置，只按 Python 自身认可的换行符切分。现成的库函数还会在换页符、垂直制表符和若干 Unicode 分隔符处断行，而 Python 分词器不认，于是字符串字面量里的一个换页符就让此后所有位置错位：一个单元在字面量中途被截断，下一个单元整个函数体丢失。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:200:_snippet.text: Extracts the source text between two character positions and trims surrounding blank space. 中文：按字符位置区间取出源码文本并去掉首尾空白。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:212:_strip_lit.text: Blanks out string and character literals and trailing comments so that braces, semicolons and quotes appearing inside text are not mistaken for structure. Written as a character-by-character scan rather than a pattern on purpose: the alternation a pattern would need backtracks catastrophically on an unterminated quote, which is the exact failure this parser was rewritten to remove. 中文：把字符串、字符字面量与行尾注释抹平，避免文本内部的花括号、分号、引号被当成结构。刻意写成逐字符扫描而非正则：正则所需的交替在遇到未闭合引号时会灾难性回溯，而那正是本解析器重写要根除的故障。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:231:_looks_lik.name: _looks_like_prose
src/ragyourcode/parser.py:231:_looks_lik.text: Decides whether a stripped comment line reads as documentation rather than as code somebody commented out or a row of dashes used as a separator. Conservative on purpose: indexing commented-out code invents vocabulary the author disowned, and a false match is worse than a missing line. Only three endings are treated as code, because a measurement showed that also rejecting a trailing comma threw away the first line of an ordinary documentation block — prose wraps on a comma far more often than code ends on one. 中文：判断一行去掉标记后的注释是文档，还是被注释掉的代码或纯分隔线。刻意保守：把注释掉的代码索引进去等于凭空造出作者已经弃用的词汇，假阳性比漏一行更糟。只把三种结尾当作代码——实测表明连逗号也算的话，会把普通文档块的第一行整个扔掉，因为散文在逗号处换行远比代码在逗号处结束常见。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:244:_doc_comme.name: _doc_comment
src/ragyourcode/parser.py:244:_doc_comme.text: Collects the documentation block written immediately above a declaration. Fourteen of the fifteen supported languages put documentation there rather than inside the body — JSDoc, Javadoc, KDoc, rustdoc, Go doc comments, XML doc comments, PHPDoc — and every one of them was discarded, because a unit's span begins at the declaration and the comment sits outside it. The same sentence indexed thirteen searchable words as a Python docstring and two as a JavaScript comment. Adjacency is required so a licence header separated by a blank line is not mistaken for documentation of the first declaration, and annotation lines are stepped over so a single override marker cannot hide the block above it. 中文：采集紧贴声明上方的文档块。十五种受支持语言里有十四种把文档写在那里而不是函数体内——JSDoc、Javadoc、KDoc、rustdoc、Go 文档注释、XML 文档注释、PHPDoc——而它们此前全被丢弃，因为单元的跨度从声明那行才开始，注释落在外面。同一句话作为 Python docstring 能索引到十三个可检索词，作为 JavaScript 注释只有两个。要求严格相邻，使被空行隔开的版权头不会被误认成第一个声明的文档；注解行会被跨过，避免一个 override 标记就挡住它上方的整块文档。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:250:_brace_dep.text: Records the running nesting depth after every line, with literals and comments already removed, so a body can later be closed by finding where the depth returns to where it started. 中文：在抹去字面量与注释后，记录每行结束时的嵌套深度，供后续用『深度回到起点』来判定函数体在哪结束。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:261:_terminate.text: Decides whether a declaration ends without ever opening a body. This single question answers both whether something counts as a unit at all and how far it reaches. A C prototype, a trait or interface method signature, a protocol requirement and a bare struct declaration all end without owning anything, and the terminator often lands on a later line than the name, which no single-line pattern can see. 中文：判断一个声明是否根本没有打开函数体就结束了。这一个问题同时回答『它算不算一个单元』和『它管到哪一行』。C 的原型声明、trait 与 interface 的方法签名、protocol 的要求项、以及裸结构体声明都不拥有任何主体，而终止符常常落在名字之后的某一行——单行模式看不见它。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:288:_opens_a_b.text: The eligibility test the specification states: something counts as a unit only when it is a named declaration that owns a body. 中文：规范给出的资格判定——只有『拥有主体的具名声明』才算一个单元。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:293:_close_bra.text: Finds the last line of a brace-delimited body by following nesting depth back to where it opened. A declaration that ends without opening anything owns exactly its own line: without that check the scan ran on to the next opening brace in the file and swallowed a whole following block into a one-line declaration. 中文：沿嵌套深度回到起点，找出花括号主体的最后一行。不打开任何主体的声明只拥有自己那一行——没有这个判断时，扫描会一直跑到文件里下一个左花括号，把后面整块内容吞进一个单行声明里。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:323:_close_end.text: Finds where a Ruby definition ends by looking for the closing keyword at the same indentation the declaration started at, and handles the one-line form that opens and closes on the same line. 中文：按声明起始的缩进层级寻找 Ruby 的结束关键字，从而确定定义在哪结束；同时处理开合同行的单行写法。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:35:_parser_fin.name: _parser_fingerprint
src/ragyourcode/parser.py:35:_parser_fin.text: A digest of this parser module, so an index can tell which parser produced it. Cached units are a function of a file's bytes and of the code that parsed them, but reuse was keyed on the bytes alone, so upgrading the parser left every unchanged file carrying units the old one produced — permanently, until that file happened to change or somebody forced a rebuild. The improvement never reached an existing index. Digesting the source rather than declaring a version number is deliberate: a comment-only edit costs one rebuild, a forgotten version bump costs silently stale structure forever, and those are not comparable. 中文：对解析器模块自身取digest，让索引知道自己是哪个解析器建的。缓存单元是文件字节与解析代码共同的产物，而复用只按字节判定，于是升级解析器后每个未改动的文件都永久沿用旧解析器的产出，直到该文件恰好变化或有人强制重建——改进从此到不了任何现存索引。摘要源码而非声明版本号是刻意的：只改注释顶多多重建一次，而漏改版本号则是永久的静默陈旧，两者代价不对等。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:401:_python_un.text: Extracts Python functions, methods and classes using the language own syntax tree, so nesting, qualified names, argument lists, called functions, imported modules and exact line ranges are precise rather than inferred. A file that will not parse is reported as a diagnostic and contributes nothing, instead of failing the whole run. 中文：用 Python 自身的语法树提取函数、方法与类，因此嵌套、限定名、参数、调用的函数、导入的模块与精确行范围都是准确的而非推断的。无法解析的文件记为一条诊断信息并贡献零个单元，而不是让整次运行失败。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:41:Declaration.text: One rule in the per-language table: what kind of thing it recognises, and the pattern that recognises it on a single line. Adding support for a language means adding rows of these, not changing the scanner. 中文：每语言规则表中的一条：它识别什么种类，以及在单行内识别它的模式。新增一门语言等于加几行这样的数据，而不是改扫描器。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:421:_python_un.text: Walks the syntax tree and records every function, method and class as a unit, building the dotted qualified name from the enclosing scope, gathering what it calls and imports, and recursing so nested definitions are indexed in their own right. 中文：遍历语法树，把每个函数、方法与类记为一个单元，按外层作用域拼出带点的限定名，收集其调用与导入，并递归下去让嵌套定义各自成为独立单元。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:443:_generic_u.name: _generic_units
src/ragyourcode/parser.py:443:_generic_u.text: Extracts declarations from any non-Python language by scanning one line at a time against that language's rule table, then closing each body by nesting depth or by the closing keyword, and attaching the documentation block written above it. Because a pattern never sees a second line, the reported line number is the loop position and cannot drift, and no declaration can swallow the ones after it. Blank lines, comments and statement continuations are skipped, and shell here-document text is treated as data so documentation inside it is never indexed as code. 中文：对任何非 Python 语言，逐行对照该语言的规则表提取声明，按嵌套深度或结束关键字闭合主体，并把写在其上方的文档块一并附上。由于模式永远看不到第二行，报告的行号就是循环位置、不会漂移，声明也无法吞掉它后面的内容。空行、注释与续行被跳过；shell 的 here-document 内容按数据处理，其中的说明文字绝不会被当成代码索引。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:466:_humanize_.text: Turns a declaration identifier into ordinary words for the generated description. 中文：把声明的标识符还原成普通词语，供生成描述使用。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:470:parse_file.text: Reads one source file and returns the code units in it, choosing the syntax-tree route for Python and the line-scanner route for every other supported language. A suffix with no rules yields nothing. A file that cannot be decoded as text or cannot be read is reported as a diagnostic rather than raising, so one unreadable file cannot stop an indexing run. 中文：读入一个源文件并返回其中的代码单元：Python 走语法树，其余支持的语言走行扫描器。没有规则的后缀返回空。无法按文本解码或读取失败的文件记为诊断信息而非抛错，因此单个坏文件不会中断整次索引。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:75:_rule.text: Compiles one declaration-recognising pattern into a table entry. 中文：把一条识别声明的模式编译成规则表条目。

src/ragyourcode/parser.py:79:_register.text: Registers one shared set of rules for several languages at once, since families such as Java, Kotlin, C-sharp and Scala declare things the same way. 中文：一次为多门语言登记同一套规则——Java、Kotlin、C#、Scala 这类家族的声明写法本就相同。

src/ragyourcode/providers.py:143:_vector.name: _vectors_from
src/ragyourcode/providers.py:143:_vector.text: Reads the vectors out of a response and refuses anything unusable: a missing data array, a count that does not match the request, a row without an embedding, a position reported twice, a non-numeric component. Width is checked rather than adopted, because a setting quietly overridden by whatever a model happened to return is indistinguishable from a setting that never worked -- so a mismatch names both numbers and stops. 中文：从响应中读出向量，并拒绝任何不可用的形态：缺 data 数组、条数与请求不符、某行没有 embedding、位置重复、分量非数值。宽度是校验而非采纳——被模型返回值悄悄覆盖的设置，与从未生效的设置无从分辨，因此不匹配时同时报出两个数字并停下。

src/ragyourcode/providers.py:37:Provider.name: ProviderError
src/ragyourcode/providers.py:37:Provider.text: Raised when an embeddings request cannot be completed as configured, and deliberately not absorbed. Falling back to the local hash would leave an index whose vectors come from two incompatible spaces, and a cosine between them is not a weak signal but a meaningless one that ranking would act on with full confidence. 中文：当嵌入请求无法按当前配置完成时抛出，且刻意不被吞掉。回退到本地哈希会留下一个向量来自两个互不兼容空间的索引，而两者之间的余弦不是弱信号，是毫无意义的数字——排序却会照单全收地据此下判断。

src/ragyourcode/providers.py:47:_describ.name: _describe_status
src/ragyourcode/providers.py:47:_describ.text: Turns an endpoint failure into something a user can act on with nothing sensitive in it.
